decisions.reason: This safety shoe line was elevated to its own page in 2024, which signals growing importance within the core business.
The comfort insole is a low-cost complement to the shoe range, but it is only mentioned on the website and could be consolidated into the FIT insole system.
The supportive insole adds variety to the accessory portfolio, though its modest visibility and overlap with the flagship moulded insole carry some risk of consolidation.
The ergonomic safety shoe series has kept a dedicated page in both years and fits the firm's innovation and comfort focus.
The firefighter boots serve a specialised segment and gained their own page in 2024, which shows the firm is investing in them.
The flagship FIT insole is featured on the home page with a concrete customer reference and is tied to the firm's foot-measurement services.
